LanguageData.MST.isCompQualityComment: Whether the item is affected by quality. Suggestion: Do not modify this after starting a game. Changing it during gameplay will not strip quality from existing items; it will only affect whether newly generated items have quality.
LanguageData.MST.equipPowerComment: A value used to quantify equipment strength, calculated solely from panel stats and does not consider any additional mechanics. The value is for reference only.
LanguageData.MST.normalMarketValueComment: The value calculated based on the crafting material and work amount. Not applicable to items that cannot be crafted.
LanguageData.MST.careIfWornByCorpseComment: Whether pawns care if this apparel was worn by a corpse. Affects mood penalty from wearing dead people's clothes.
LanguageData.MST.careIfDamagedComment: Whether pawns care about the condition of this apparel. Affects mood penalty from wearing tattered apparel.
LanguageData.MST.developmentalStageFilterComment: Which developmental stages can wear this apparel. Newborn/Baby/Child/Adult.
LanguageData.MST.apparelTagListComment: Tags this apparel carries. Pawn generation only picks apparel sharing a tag with the pawn kind's apparel tags; tag-filtered requirements and random loot rely on it too. Empty means it is never picked by tag.
LanguageData.MST.breathingSupplyComment: Tri-state: 1 = force yes; 0 = force no; -1 = auto (by vacuum resistance). 0 and -1 mean different things.
LanguageData.MST.aoApparelConfigComment: Atmosphere Overhaul's apparel extension: breathing supply, pressure shell, air tank capacity, suit pressure. Only apparel carrying it (oxygen masks, pressure suits) has these fields.
LanguageData.MST.pressureShellComment: Tri-state: 1 = force yes; 0 = force no; -1 = auto (whether it covers the torso). 0 and -1 mean different things.
LanguageData.MST.capacityAirTanksComment: Air tank capacity; 0 or less = auto (max(1, round(3 x vacuum resistance))).
LanguageData.MST.suitPressureHpaComment: Pressure held inside the shell (hPa); sea level on Earth is about 1013.
LanguageData.MST.aoApparelNote: Breathing supply and pressure shell are tri-state: 1 = force yes, 0 = force no, -1 = auto. Vacuum helmets get their breathing supply from AO's vacuum resistance, not from this extension.
